# LOOKIQ

> LOOKIQ (lookiqfashion.com) is a curated Amazon fashion destination for US women shoppers — quiet-luxury and designer-inspired finds, honest buying guides with prices from the product listings, and outfit ideas.
> LOOKIQ is an Amazon Associate: product links on the site are affiliate links, and LOOKIQ earns from qualifying purchases.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://lookiqfashion.com/): Curated Amazon fashion finds for women — quiet-luxury and designer-inspired pieces, buying guides and outfit ideas.
- [Shop](https://lookiqfashion.com/shop.html): The full LOOKIQ catalogue of curated Amazon fashion products for women, newest first.
- [Guides](https://lookiqfashion.com/guides.html): All LOOKIQ buying guides and reviews — honest picks with prices and ratings taken from the product listings.
- [Top Sellers](https://lookiqfashion.com/top-sellers.html): LOOKIQ's most popular and best-rated Amazon fashion picks in one place.
- [Holiday Event Shop](https://lookiqfashion.com/holiday-event-shop.html): Holiday and event outfits — Thanksgiving, Black Friday, Christmas parties, Hanukkah and New Year's Eve picks.
- [Look for Less](https://lookiqfashion.com/look-for-less.html): Designer-inspired looks for less — high-end styles matched with affordable Amazon alternatives.
- [Lookbook](https://lookiqfashion.com/lookbook.html): Outfit inspiration and styled looks built from LOOKIQ's Amazon fashion finds.
- [Free Guide — 25 Finds Under $50](https://lookiqfashion.com/freebie-25-finds-under-50.html): A free guide to 25 Amazon fashion finds under $50 from the LOOKIQ Style Club.
